description: Use this when you need to see exactly what changed between two script versions. Structured geometric delta between two versions of a kernelCAD script — a baseline ({ base_file } or { base_code }) and a revision ({ file } or { code }). Returns agent-readable JSON: per-part added/removed/renamed/changed (volume mm³ + exact bbox deltas, numbers matching inspect({ of: 'part-stats' })), total interference-volume delta with per-pair detail, mate-graph changes (added/removed/changed mates incl. type, connectors, pose, limits, coupleMates coupling), and param changes (value/min/max). Single-shape scripts diff as one "(root)" pseudo-part; a `return [a, b]` multi-body script diffs per body as "body[0]", "body[1]". An error that still leaves geometry (e.g. a skipped fillet) is listed under base/revised.errors beside the diff. Use after editing a script to verify exactly what changed physically before re-rendering. On a hosted server pass both versions inline: { base_code: 'return box(10, 10, 10);', code: 'return box(10, 10, 12);' } (base_code/old_code/before and revised_code/new_code/after are accepted as aliases). Read-only — never touches the active session. Iterating on a saved project: pass file "project:<slug>" plus `patch` ([{ old, new }], each old exactly once) instead of resending the script; nothing is saved until open_in_studio.

base_code.description: Baseline (before) script — inline source. One of base_file / base_code is required.

base_file.description: Baseline (before) script — path to a .kcad.ts file. Local servers only.

code.description: Revised (after) script — inline source. One of file / code is required.

file.description: Revised (after) script — path to a .kcad.ts file. Local servers only. Hosted: `code`, `project:<slug>` (head), or a Studio `/p/<slug>?version=N` link (pinned); no local files.

patch.description: Edit-and-test in place: use with file "project:<slug>" instead of resending the script. Each { old, new } replaces text that must occur exactly once in the saved source (no match or several matches is an error and nothing runs); edits apply in order. The tool runs on the patched source; nothing is saved and the saved project stays the base for the next call. To keep the change, call open_in_studio with project "<slug>" (no code) right after a successful evaluate_script (it saves that patched source). Not allowed together with `code`.

new.description: Replacement text (may be empty to delete).

old.description: Exact text in the saved source; must occur exactly once.

name: diff_scripts
title: Diff CAD Scripts
